Problem Description: LEM issue
Please note that during the analysis of the charger and error flags, it was observed that the LEM is experiencing an issue. Among the LEM error flags, the critical error flag detected is "Tampering Detected." This indicates that unauthorized manipulation may have occurred. To address this, please inspect the device's integrity, including the manufacturer seals, front panel of the Meter Unit, and Meter Unit housing for signs of forced opening. In both scenarios, it is necessary to replace both components of the LEM, namely the Sensing Unit and Metering Unit. Below are the part numbers for your reference to order and carry out the replacement activity.
